```{r setup3, include=FALSE}
status_circle <- function(x) {
  sprintf('<span class="status-circle %s">%s</span>', x, x)
}
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# evaluate some parameters
rasters <- if (!is.null(params$raster_files)) lapply(params$raster_files, terra::rast) else NULL
years <- params$years %||% numeric(0)
n <- length(rasters)

terraOptions(progress = 0)

```

Assessed on `r format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B %Y")` `r 
{
  parts <- c()
  
  if (!is.null(params$author) && nzchar(params$author))
    parts <- c(parts, paste0("by ", params$author))
  
  if (!is.null(params$email) && nzchar(params$email))
    parts <- c(parts, paste0("(", params$email, ")"))
  
  if (!is.null(params$organisation) && nzchar(params$organisation))
    parts <- c(parts, paste0("affiliated to ", params$organisation))
  
  if (length(parts) > 0)
    paste(parts, collapse = " ")
  else
    ""
}`

# **Report summary**

This report documents an ecosystem assessment following the IUCN Red List of Ecosystems (RLE) Guidelines, for the `r params$ecosystem_name` `r if(length(params$years) == 0) {        "with no raster years uploaded"      } else if(length(params$years) == 1) {        paste("using data from", params$years)      } else {        paste("using data between", min(params$years), "and", max(params$years))      }`. This report has been created from the Ecosystem Classification Assessment Tool (EcoCAT) developed as part of the EcoCAT project from RBG Kew. 

 - This tool and report currently covers **Criterion A** and **Criterion B** of the RLE assessment. 
 - The graphs in this report can be downloaded by selecting the 'download as png' icon at the top of each graph.
 - To download the data and mapping files as part of this assessment, please revisit the 'Report/Data download' tab in the tool, select the required data files for download and select the 'Download data' button.
